judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is incomplete, having stopped mid-task as shown by its own `.lore/dod.md` checklist. In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, `ToolRegistry.register` compiles the schema (incorrectly doing so even for function-valued definitions), but `ToolRegistry.execute` was not modified at all and never calls `validateInput`. Consequently, three of the four acceptance tests the candidate wrote in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail, and `import Ajv from 'ajv'` may also cause TypeScript ESM interop issues compared to the reference's `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`. Furthermore, the candidate is missing dynamic schema WeakMap caching, the `execute` JSDoc comment, most unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and all required documentation updates in `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`.
